name: Mutation Fog
description: A fog of transmutative fumes fills a 30-foot radius area, painfully mutating creatures who enter.
disable: DC 35 Nature (master) to neutralize the fog, or DC 35 Survival (master) to disperse the fog

offensiveAbilities.name: Harmful Mutation
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature begins its turn in the fog

Effect The fog surges with energy, dealing (6d10+27) Bludgeoning Damage damage to all creatures in the fog as it harmfully mutates their bodies. Creatures in the area must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage. It resists mutation.

Failure The creature takes full damage. Its flesh becomes coated in foul-smelling blisters for 1 hour. For as long as it has this mutation, it is Sickened 1 and can't reduce the value of its sickened condition.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. Its limbs become painfully twisted for 1d4 hours. For as long as it has this mutation, it is Sickened 2 and can't reduce the value of its sickened condition.
